title: 117 Partners CEO calls on Cardano Foundation to disclose use of 1,090 BTC
summary: Thomas Braziel, CEO of crypto investment and advisory firm 117 Partners, has called for the Cardano (ADA) Foundation to disclose its use of Bitcoin (BTC). In a post on X, Braziel stated that after reviewing corporate registration documents and the official Cardano website, he found that the foundation's initial entity, the Manx Foundation, was established during its 2015 ICO with Cardano founder Charles Hoskinson serving as a director. This foundation appears to have received approximately 1,090 BTC. Braziel noted that since the foundation was dissolved in December 2025, it needs to release documents related to its governance and the use of the BTC. He clarified that he is not currently alleging any wrongdoing but is demanding a higher level of transparency.

title: Zcash developers propose upgrade to block counterfeit ZEC
summary: Zcash (ZEC) developers have proposed a new shielded pool upgrade, named Ironwood, to bolster supply verification following a recently patched vulnerability in the Orchard privacy pool. According to Cointelegraph, developer ZODL and the Zcash Foundation plan to introduce a formal verification and independent audit system to Ironwood. The proposal outlines that the existing Orchard pool will halt new deposits and internal transactions, with funds being migrated to Ironwood through a verification process called a turnstile.

title: Ethereum co-founder's 110K ETH move is to prevent liquidation, not a sale
summary: A transfer of 110,000 ETH from a wallet belonging to Ethereum co-founder Joseph Lubin, the first such move in three years, was intended to defend against liquidation rather than for a sale, Crypto Briefing reported. The funds were deposited into a Sky Protocol (formerly MakerDAO) vault. Lubin has a total of 412,430 WETH locked as collateral across three Sky vaults. The protocol allows users to borrow the DAI stablecoin by depositing cryptocurrency as collateral.
